title: Level 3 Art History — Style in Art Works 2024
subject: art-history

questions.text:
There is ONE question to answer.

Style refers to the characteristics of an art work that, when combined, distinguish the style of an artist, art movement, period, or place. These characteristics may include ways of using line, colour, tone, light, form, composition, space, scale, shape, mass, texture, ornament, and media.

Select and name TWO art works from your studied area(s). These art works may be from the same area of study, or from two different areas of study.

Choose TWO of the following stylistic characteristics: Space, Composition, Form, Media, Colour, Modernist design.

(a) Using supporting evidence from your two selected art works and their contexts, explain the treatment of the chosen characteristics in each of the two art works.

(b) Explain the reasons for the similarities and differences between the styles of the two art works, with reference to the time and place in which each artist was working.

Aim for a concise response of no more than 5-6 pages.
questions.markingGuide: Achievement (3-4 marks): Demonstrate understanding of style by analysing art works to explain stylistic characteristics and identify similarities and/or differences in style between art works, using supporting evidence. The candidate uses some appropriate terminology to explain stylistic characteristics in each of two selected art works, and has clearly identified similarities and/or differences in style. Some references to specific features have been used. Merit (5-6 marks): Demonstrate in-depth understanding by analysing art works to justify reasons for similarities and/or differences in style, using supporting evidence. The candidate has analysed using appropriate terminology, justified the reasons for similarities and/or differences. Significant evidence has been used. The analysis has been supported by in-depth explanation of specific features and/or references to specified context(s). Excellence (7-8 marks): Demonstrate perceptive understanding by providing an insightful explanation of the reasons for similarities and/or differences in style, using supporting evidence from art works and/or their context(s). The analysis has been supported by in-depth explanation of specific features in both selected art works, evidence from the art works, and references to the specified context(s). The explanations and use of terminology demonstrate comprehensive and insightful understanding.
